_comment: Brief 81 P4 — EnergyPlus locator config for the validation harness.
The runner (P7, validation/energyplus/run.py) resolves the EnergyPlus install in this order:
1. ENERGYPLUS_DIR environment variable, if set (overrides this file — keeps the harness portable).
This file is the 'config file, not global install' the brief requires: EnergyPlus is NOT on PATH and
no system environment was modified (divergence D1 — we use the pre-existing C:\EnergyPlusV26-1-0
install rather than a fresh contained one). The install dir itself is outside the repo, so nothing
binary is committed. Paths use forward slashes; both Python and Node accept them on Windows.
Verified 2026-06-02: bundled ExampleFiles/1ZoneEvapCooler.idf ran clean (0 severe, 1 warning) and
produced a 3.1 MB eplusout.eso — see audit docs/audit/81_energyplus_validation_box.md §4.
